blocks.html: For many of us, the scramble to secure gifts for our friends and family can tend to drain us mentally and financially. So if you’ve been racking your brains for budget-friendly gift ideas, Robinsons Novaliches offers a more convenient and safer way to help you tick off items in your Christmas list with its Christmas Bazaar!

“It’s the most beautiful time of the year,” so they say. However, this year, Christmas time can be very difficult for all sorts of reasons which leads us to highlight one of the true essences of Christmas and a staple Filipino tradition – gift-giving to your loved ones.

Luckily for those who live far away in the north, the outdoor bazaar features 85 stalls located at Parking 2 of the mall, offering a wide variety of gift items, from fashionable clothes and shoes, stylish phone accessories, household items, knick-knacks of all sorts, and so much more. This is where you can buy exactly everything in one place, so put on your walking shoes and get ready to haggle.

Robinsons Novaliches started its annual Christmas Bazaar last 2005 and is now on its 15th year giving the residents of Quezon City (Novaliches and Fairview), Caloocan City, and even as far as San Jose del Monte, Bulacan an all-access to finest pieces for the lowest prices!

Nerve yourself for a whopping collection of every gift and goodie imaginable both for you and your loved ones. Looking for work-from-home items that will make you feel like a major boss like a cellphone stand, neck pillow, or ring light? Face masks and face shields that would definitely go together with your OOTD? Or comfortable lounge wear, statement shirts, and even pajama sets that are picture-perfect for your fun virtual parties and energetic tiktok videos? Cop what they deem as the best holiday finds at this Christmas bazaar.

And after a day of walking or while going around the bazaar, shoppers can also buy quick snacks like ihaw-ihaw or potato fries and even full meals like samgyupsal or shawarma to put in their stomach at the food stalls available.

No need to rush as Robinsons Novaliches 2020 Christmas Bazaar is open every day until January 3, 2021 from 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM, giving shoppers all the time they need to stretch their budget and end up purchasing finds they didn’t even know they wanted!

Make sure to come prepared to maximize your shopping experience! Health and safety protocols are implemented to prevent the spread of the virus such as regular/daily sanitation, temperature check in all entrances with alcohol dispensers, health protocol marshal reminding customers to observe physical distancing, and mandatory wearing of face mask and face shield within the vicinity.

Ready your wallet and bring an ecobag as you will surely go home not empty-handed! For more updates, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or like RobinsonsNovaliches on Facebook; follow @robinsonsnovaliches on Instagram and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter.
